regions.label: INES_Header
regions.evidence: Validated iNES magic, mapper 1 and declared PRG/CHR lengths; run.py inspect.

regions.label: CHR_PatternROM
regions.evidence: Header declares 128 KiB CHR ROM after PRG; NES planar 8x8 pattern tiles, separate PPU storage; not CPU executable.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Three little endian interrupt vectors: NMI $C000, reset $FFD8, IRQ $C000, fixed banks 14/15.
